description: Retrato editorial em céu aberto no fim da tarde. Contraluz de recorte + preenchimento pela cúpula do céu — a divergência de temperatura entre sol quente e céu frio assina exterior real. Uso: capa editorial em locação, retrato de reportagem.

ask_before.prompt: Descreva a pessoa: idade aproximada, pele, cabelo, formato de rosto. Sem nome — pessoa real identificável é vetada.
Duas assimetrias específicas em eixos independentes.
Marcas preservadas com posição — inclua marcas de idade quando fizer sentido (dano solar, rugas de expressão).
Expressão específica. Em contraluz forte, considere 'apertou levemente os olhos contra a luz'.
Peça principal, com tecido nomeado. Fibra natural (lã, algodão penteado, tweed) responde melhor ao contraluz.
Locação: campo aberto, rua urbana, orla, terraço. Determina o preenchimento e a perspectiva atmosférica.

scene.headline: Editorial outdoor portrait in late-afternoon light, waist-up

subject.vellus_hair: the vellus and stray hair at the crown catch the rim light as a fine halo

wardrobe.weave: brushed wool with visible surface fibre
tension_creases: compression creases where the collar meets the neck
a slight roll where the shoulder seam rises
wardrobe.drape: the wool falls with structured weight, holding a broad fold rather than a fluid one

out_of_focus: the far eye falls just outside critical focus
the background 40 metres out is separated by atmospheric perspective

camera.perspective_note: 50mm on full frame renders the head at natural perspective without wide-angle exaggeration

optics.bokeh_character: smooth centre with cat-eye deformation on the frame edges from wide-open aperture
optics.chromatic_aberration: faint magenta-green longitudinal fringe on the specular highlights at the hair edge
optics.vignetting: half a stop of mechanical vignetting in the corners
optics.veiling_flare: low-contrast veiling flare across the right third of the frame from the sun in the angle of incidence, and a single weak hexagonal ghost

sources.elevation: 8 degrees above the horizon, behind and camera-right of the subject

lighting.shadow_direction: falls long and toward camera-left, penumbra narrow near the feet and widening with distance
lighting.contact_shadow: the shadow of the wardrobe meets the ground densely under the feet and opens into a soft penumbra with distance

catchlight.shape: a small round concentrated specular from the sun, offset to the upper temporal side of each iris
catchlight.position: upper-right in the near eye, mirrored in the far eye
catchlight.far_eye: smaller and dimmer in the far eye, with a broad diffuse fill from the sky dome as a secondary highlight in the lower half of the iris

lighting.mixed_temperature: The 3200K rim from the sun and the 12000K fill from the sky diverge sharply; the face-side shadow reads blue while the rim stays warm. That temperature divergence is what signs the frame as outdoor.

skin.pore_scale: true pore scale for this framing, with the vellus catching the rim
skin.specular_zones: sebum sheen concentrated on the nose bridge and forehead centre; the T-zone is measurably brighter than the cheeks
skin.subsurface: subsurface scattering reddens the ear rims and the outer nostrils where the sun grazes
skin.regional_variation: fine dryness on the cheekbones and lower lip, with two visible vertical creases in the lower lip

render.palette_note: warm midtones from the low sun, cool shadows from the sky, greens pulled slightly cool
render.highlight_rolloff: gradual rolloff on the rim without clipping the specular on the crown
render.black_point: the deepest shadow near 8 percent luminance rather than pure black
render.grain: fine luminance grain consistent with ISO 100

frame.composition: subject placed slightly camera-left of centre with the gaze opening into the larger negative space
frame.headroom: moderate headroom, roughly 10 percent of frame height

environment.horizon: level with the subject's chin line
environment.sky_fill: open sky dome at 12000K, two and a half stops under the sun, opening the shadow side of the face to a cool blue
environment.atmospheric_perspective: the background 40 metres out drops in contrast and saturation, separating from the subject without depending on aperture alone
contact_points: under the feet against the ground

imperfection_budget.specific: the wind has lifted the collar on one side and left it there
the subject squinted slightly against the sun, and the near eye reads narrower than a controlled studio blink

defaults.capture_reality: A single frame from a working editorial session at the end of the afternoon
avoid: flare without a sun in the angle of incidence

example_answers.meta.user_request: retrato editorial de um homem mais velho ao ar livre no fim da tarde
example_answers.subject.description: A 68-year-old man with weathered fair skin, grey-green eyes, close-cropped silver hair and a strong jaw softened by age
subject.asymmetries: the right expression line at the outer eye reads deeper than the left
the left corner of the mouth carries a longer downward crease
subject.preserved_marks: diffuse sun damage across the temples
a 3mm faded scar on the chin
two age spots at the left temple
capillary flush on the nose bridge
example_answers.subject.expression: he has squinted slightly against the low sun, the mouth closed and the jaw set
example_answers.wardrobe.0.garment: a dark navy brushed-wool overshirt over a plain oatmeal T-shirt
example_answers.environment.description: a low urban rooftop with a distant industrial skyline 40 metres out and no direct architecture behind the subject
